fixes: Outline (the riverfront south of the white riverboat): the wide grey-beige paved promenade that runs along the water ends in a hard, squared-off edge, and a much narrower cream footpath carries on along the shore below it. Remove that hard end. The promenade's landward (left) edge curves gently toward the water over the lower half of the outline so the promenade narrows smoothly, like a road tapering, until it is exactly as wide as the cream footpath and joins it in one continuous ribbon along the shore: no step, no corner, no straight cut across it. Its colour passes from the promenade's grey-beige to the footpath's cream where the two widths meet, in one clean soft join. The thin pale kerb along the water continues unbroken down the shore. The water's edge does not move.

On the lawn left of the promenade inside the outline there is a broken tree: a round tree at the top, a long dark-green diagonal smear running down from it, and half a tree cut off at the promenade's end. Remove the smear and the half tree completely. In their place draw two whole small round trees in a row on the lawn beside the promenade, the same size, shape, leaf-green and short brown trunk as the small round trees along the pond's path just to the left, each standing on the lawn with a small soft shadow at its foot. The lawn around them is the lawn's own flat yellow-green, including the ground the promenade no longer covers.
Keep the thin dark lamp post that stands on the promenade near the top of the outline, the same size, standing on the paving.
